_comment: CAP2_BACK_CLOSURE — generator-authored hardware detail on the back of Cap 2. A separate slot from the front motif; they never conflict because they sit on different views. Derived from the source back view rather than invented: the adjuster opening is the enclosed transparent gap at row 13, cols 8-11, and the closure sits on the fabric directly above it, where a real snapback strap goes.

derivation.closure_band: rows 10-11, the fabric immediately above the opening

colour.why: the palette's hardware ramp is metal — the right material for a buckle — and its light end reads as pale hardware against the back fabric
colour.measured: 107-124 luminance above the tinted back at these cells
colour.must_not: use the opening shadow or the outline role
